roleCountMismatch: Choose exactly {{count}} role cards to match the players.
roleSlotsExceeded: There are not enough player slots for this role.
handoverBody: Give the phone to the next player. Keep the screen turned away until it is in your hands.
roleRevealHint: Make sure nobody else can see the screen.
distributionCompleteBody: The cards have been dealt. Return the phone to the narrator.
narratorWarningBody: The narrator is now using the phone. Make sure no players can see the screen.
gameStartedBody: The narrator guides night actions and records the Village's in-person vote.

game.nightInstruction: Follow each role prompt in order. Wake only the players named on the screen, record their choices, then announce the morning.
game.twoSistersReminder: Wake {{names}} together so they recognize each other.

log.mentorChosen: The Wild Child chose {{name}} as their mentor.
log.littleGirlReminder: The Little Girl may have spied while the Werewolves were awake.
log.wolfAttack: The Werewolves chose {{name}} as their victim.
log.attackBlockedByProtector: {{name}} survived the Werewolves' attack because of the Protector.
log.attackBlockedByWitch: {{name}} survived the Werewolves' attack because of the Witch's save potion.
log.attackBlockedByShepherd: {{name}} was protected from the Werewolves by a sheep.
log.elderSurvived: The Elder, {{name}}, survived the first Werewolf attack.
log.witchKill: The Witch used the kill potion on {{target}}.
log.witchPassed: The Witch kept both potions unused tonight.
log.witchSaved: The Witch used the save potion on {{target}}.
log.ravenMarked: The Raven marked {{name}} for two extra votes tomorrow.
log.whiteWolfStopped: The White Werewolf chose not to kill tonight.
log.sheepAteWolf: A sheep was sent to a Werewolf; {{name}} was eaten and the sheep was lost.
log.alienCorrect: The Alien guessed {{target}}'s role correctly. {{target}} was killed.
log.alienWrong: The Alien guessed {{target}}'s role incorrectly and died.
log.monkeyInvestigated: The Genius Monkey investigated {{target}} and found {{role}}.
log.bearGrowl: {{name}}'s bear growled. A Werewolf is seated beside them.

game.rebouteuxInstruction: Restore one used, one-time ability belonging to another living player.
game.littleGirlReminder: The Little Girl may secretly spy while the Werewolves are awake. If caught, she can become their victim.
game.skipAction: Save no one and use no potion
game.noDeaths: No one died during the night.
game.villagePowersDisabled: The Elder was eliminated by the Village. Village special powers are disabled.
game.bearGrowls: The Bear Tamer's bear growls: a Werewolf is seated next to them.
game.bearQuiet: The Bear Tamer's bear is quiet.
game.servantChoice: Will the Devoted Servant take this role?
game.servantHint: {{name}} was eliminated by the Village. The Servant may take this role now.
game.dayInstruction: Announce the morning results and let the Village discuss and vote in person. The narrator records the agreed result here.
game.offlineVoteInstruction: Hold the discussion and vote away from the phone. Select the result and the reason for the elimination below.
game.ravenVotesNotice: The Raven marked {{name}} for two additional votes today.
game.barberInstruction: If the Barber gives the agreed signal, choose a player to eliminate.
game.judgeSecondVote: Judge called a second vote: record its result
game.voteTie: The vote is tied. No one is eliminated.

reaction.hunter: The Hunter chooses someone to take with them
reaction.colossus: Choose a Werewolf to take with you

reactionHint.hunter: The Hunter has just been announced dead. Hand them the phone now so they can choose one player to die with them.
reactionHint.colossus: The Colossus has learned who the Werewolves are. Choose one of them.

action.cupid: On the first night, choose two players to become Lovers.
action.wildChild: Choose the player who will be your mentor.
action.wolves: The Werewolves choose one living player to attack. The Father of Wolves may infect this victim instead.
action.protector: Choose a player to protect. You cannot protect the same player on two consecutive nights.
action.seer: Choose a player to learn their exact role.
action.witch: Choose whether to save the Werewolves' victim, use your kill potion, or save both potions.
action.raven: Choose a player who will receive two additional votes tomorrow.
action.whiteWerewolf: Choose a living Werewolf to kill.
action.shepherd: Send a sheep to protect a Villager. A sheep sent to a Werewolf is consumed and kills that Werewolf.
action.alien: Choose a player and guess their exact role. A correct guess kills them; a wrong guess kills you.
action.geniusMonkey: Investigate one player at a time. If you find a Werewolf, the Genius Monkey dies immediately; otherwise, continue or stop.

endGameConfirm: End this game and delete its saved data? This cannot be undone.
savedGameExpired: This saved game has been inactive for more than 30 minutes.
replaceSavedBody: Starting a new game will delete the current saved game.
loadError: The saved game could not be opened.
privacyNote: Game data stays in this browser. It is not encrypted against someone with access to this device's browser data.
invalidTransition: That action is not available at this stage.
nameRequired: Enter your name before revealing your role.
roleCountMismatchError: The selected role cards must match the number of players.
roleSlotsExceededError: The selected roles exceed the player count.
sameProtectorTarget: The Protector cannot protect the same player two nights in a row.
judgeUnavailable: The Judge's extra vote is unavailable.
